questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why air conditioning is becoming cheaper in India
How the human body cools itself down
The hottest cities in the world
A simple way of keeping poor families' homes cool in India
questions.why: Neil says they'll hear about an innovative idea for keeping houses cool in India.

questions.q: How does Beth feel about hot weather?
options: She loves it, though it can get too hot
She hates it and stays indoors all day
She only enjoys it when she's on holiday
She is afraid of getting badly sunburnt
questions.why: Beth says she loves hot weather, but sometimes it gets too hot, even for her.

questions.q: What does the Mahila Housing Trust do?
options: It builds new houses for construction workers
It helps poor women heat-proof their homes
It gives families free air conditioning units
It trains women to work on building sites
questions.why: It is an NGO helping poor Indian women to heat-proof their houses.

questions.q: Which of these does Roshni Diwakar NOT mention about the typical house?
options: It has no windows
It often has a tin roof
It has a garden for sitting outside
Electricity is not available all day
questions.why: She mentions no windows, power cuts and tin roofs, but not a garden.

questions.q: Why does the heat cause money problems for these families?
options: Sick workers can't work, so they earn nothing
They have to pay high electricity bills for fans
They must buy expensive medicine every week
Their rent goes up sharply every summer
questions.why: They are daily wage earners: 'if you don't work you don't earn'.

questions.q: What can white anti-solar roof paint do?
options: Make houses completely cool
Lower room temperatures by up to 4 degrees
Produce electricity for the house
Stop power cuts in the summer
questions.why: Neil says reflective white paint can reduce room temperatures by up to 4 degrees.

questions.q: What does Neil suggest about a drop of 4 degrees?
options: It is too small to make any real difference
It is only really useful at night, when people sleep
It works only in dry desert cities like Delhi
It sounds small, but families can live inside
questions.why: He says it may not sound like much, but it allows families to work, cook and even sleep inside.

questions.q: How much of the paint's price do communities usually pay?
options: All of it
About half
Only 15 to 20%
Nothing at all
questions.why: The trust subsidises the paint, so communities only pay 15 to 20% of the price.
